sharedChrome: See _shared-chrome.json for header/sidebar controls present on this and every other authenticated screen. Default landing screen immediately after login.

components.name: Menu (#cpBody_bpagar)
components.action: Dropdown toggle button labeled 'Menu' in the page-title-actions area. Opens a dropdown containing at least the 'Histórico' link (see below).

components.name: Histórico (nav-link, inside the Menu dropdown)
components.action: href="#", opens the 'Historial Guías' filter modal in place (#modal_Historial) — see rastreo-historico-modal sub-view below.

components.name: Packages grid (#cpBody_gvDatos)
components.action: DevExpress grid grouped by status (e.g. 'Estatus: Embarcado'). Columns: Post-Alerta, AD, Guia, Fecha, Tracking, Peso, FOB, Contenido, Suplidor, RT, Servicio, Total. Rows are grouped/collapsible (group header row has an expand/collapse toggle, ASPx.GVCollapseRow).

components.name: Adjuntos count icon (per row, e.g. text '0' linking to dlg/Adjuntos.aspx)
components.action: Real link, href pattern 'dlg/Adjuntos.aspx?o=Rastreo.aspx&cl=<guia>&c=<code>'. Opens the Adjuntos attachments dialog as a browser popup — see rastreo-adjuntos sub-view below.

components.name: Tracking number link (e.g. 'DP01-00306834')
components.action: href="#", onclick="VerGuia('<tracking>')". Opens the 'Movimientos del Paquete' modal in place — see rastreo-movimientos-modal sub-view below.

components.name: Row '...' / additional-actions icon (e.g. #cpBody_gvDatos_DXCBtn1, class dxgvADSB)
components.action: DevExpress command-column button, href="javascript:;". Per Phase 1 testing, expands an inline master-detail row panel showing Suplidor, RT, Servicio, Total — no navigation, no distinct URL (DevExpress grid feature, not a separate screen).

components.name: Group header row (e.g. 'Estatus: Embarcado')
components.action: Non-interactive group-by-status label with an expand/collapse image control (ASPx.GVCollapseRow).

components.name: Guia detail grid (#cpBody_ppCambioGuia_gvDetalles)
components.action: DevExpress grid grouped by 'Guia: <tracking>'. Columns: Tracking, Estatus, Fecha. For the test record, 1 row: TBA334226770293 / Embarcado / 9/2/2026 4:43:55 PM.

components.name: Movimientos modal container
components.action: In-page modal/popup with no distinct URL; dismissed with Escape in this audit (no explicit close button captured in the DOM dump — worth checking for a visible close (X) affordance in the UX review).

subViews.name: Historial Guías filter modal

components.name: Historial Guias dialog (#modal_Historial)
components.action: Bootstrap modal, class 'modal-full'. Has a header with title 'Historial Guias' and a close (×) button.

components.name: Fecha Desde (#cpBody_lDesde)
components.action: type=date, start of the date range filter.

components.name: Fecha Hasta (#cpBody_lHasta)
components.action: type=date, end of the date range filter.

components.name: Buscar
components.action: onclick="Filtro()". Presumed to query historical guias within the selected date range; not exercised further (no results grid captured in this dump).

components.name: Stray 'gv' text near Buscar button
components.action: Rendering glitch already flagged in Phase 1: literal text 'gv' appears between the Fecha Hasta field and the Buscar button — looks like a leaked DevExpress grid element ID/placeholder rendered as visible text. Confirmed again in this dump (modal body text reads '...Fecha Hasta: gv Buscar').

notes: Also confirmed in this dump: the modal partially overlaps the top nav bar (visual/z-index issue), consistent with the Phase 1 screenshot.

subViews.name: Adjuntos (attachments) dialog

components.name: Attachments grid (#gvDatos)
components.action: DevExpress grid, columns: Codigo, Nombre, Fecha, Objeto, Adjunto. Empty for the test record ('No data to display').

notes: No upload/attach control was found in the DOM for this record — either attachments are add-only from the PreAlerta flow, or an upload affordance only appears once at least one row context exists / a different permission applies. Worth a follow-up in Phase 3 if attaching a file becomes in-scope (would be a real, hard-to-reverse action, so treat cautiously).

subViews.name: Grid row detail expander (inline, not a distinct screen)
notes: Not re-captured with a DOM dump in this phase (best-effort selector attempt failed/timed out); documented from Phase 1 evidence: clicking the row's '...' icon expands an inline panel showing Suplidor, RT, Servicio, Total. Confirmed as the same command-column button pattern seen at #cpBody_gvDatos_DXCBtn1 above.

The header area also displays the logged-in user's name and email (e.g. 'JOSE ALEXANDER CABREJA AYBAR' / 'jacabreja@hotmail.com') near the 'Salir' dropdown — present as static text, not individually selectored in this dump; treat as a status/display element in the shared header chrome.
